result_text:
`PromotionService.createPromotion` now trims the promotion code (`code = code.trim();`) right after the required-code check, in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/service/PromotionService.java`.

A code like `"  SPRING10 "` is now stored and shown as `SPRING10`, and it is found by `SPRING10`. Creating `SPRING10` again, with or without spaces, is rejected as a duplicate, because the duplicate check uses the trimmed code too.

I ran the tests matching `*Promotion*` and they passed. I didn't add a test for the trimming case. I also didn't touch promotions already saved with spaces, so any existing ones stay as they are.
